top_strength: Joanna gathered full logistics details (addresses, room count, special items, packing scope, box estimate) and successfully transitioned the call to a virtual walkthrough with clear scheduling (Thursday 11:00 AM, link via text).
coaching_note: Before routing to walkthrough, ask the two-concerns question to understand what matters most to Rebecca, then deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee with exact terms plus damage coverage) to address her core worries — you skipped this entirely and jumped straight into logistics, losing the emotional anchor that drives booking.
